summary: Climber fell 30 feet on steep snow on the Lambslide/Broadway, Longs Peak, injuring shoulder; ranger simul-rappel and horse evacuation.
notes: NPS morning report account (filed Mon Jul 25, 2011 — 68 YOM Boulder man, 30-ft sliding fall near top of Lamb's Slide Friday afternoon, cell-phone call, tandem rappel/lowering to Mills Glacier, 10 rangers involved).
